label: Custom logic file
description: Path to a custom logic file.

label: Close Cows
description: When playing Epona's Song for a group of cows, the closest cow will respond, instead of the default behavior.

label: Arrow Cycling
description: Cycle through arrow types when pressing R while an arrow is out when using the bow.

label: Disable Crit Wiggle
description: Disable crit wiggle movement modification when 1 heart of health or less.

label: Hash Icons .png
description: Draw hash icons on the File Select screen.

label: Elegy Speedup
description: Applies various Elegy of Emptiness speedups.

label: Fast Push
description: Increase the speed of pushing and pulling blocks and faucets.

label: Trap Quirks
description: Ice traps will behave slightly differently from other items in certain situations.

label: Update World Models
description: Show world models as their actual item instead of the original item. This includes Pieces of Heart, Heart Containers, Skulltula Tokens, Stray Fairies, Moon's Tear and the Seahorse.

label: Ocarina Underwater
description: Enable using the ocarina underwater.

label: Quest Item Storage
description: Enable Quest Item Storage, which allows for storing multiple quest items in their dedicated inventory slot. Quest items will also always be consumed when used.

label: Continuous Deku Hopping
description: Press A while hopping across water to keep hopping.

label: Iron Goron
description: Goron Link will sink in water instead of drowning.

label: Update Shop Appearance
description: Shops models and text will be updated to match the item they give.

label: Progressive Upgrades
description: Enable swords, wallets, magic, bomb bags, quivers and the Goron Lullaby to be found in the intended order.

label: Target Health Bar
description: Targeting an enemy shows their health bar.

label: Climb Most Surfaces
description: Link can climb most surfaces.

label: Free Scarecrow
description: Spawn scarecrow automatically when using ocarina if within range.

label: Fill Wallet
description: Fills wallet with max rupees upon finding a wallet upgrade.

label: Auto Invert
description: Auto-invert time at the start of a cycle.

label: Giant Mask Anywhere
description: Allows the Giant's Mask to be used anywhere with a high enough (or no) ceiling.

label: Double Archery Rewards
description: Grant both archery rewards with a sufficient score.

label: Hidden Rupees Sparkle
description: Hit Tags and Invisible Rupees will emit a sparkle.

label: Chest Game Minimap
description: Draws a minimap during the Treasure Chest Game if you have the Map of Clock Town:

options.label: Off
options.description: No minimap, default vanilla behaviour.

options.label: Minimal
options.description: Minimap is displayed, blocks appear on minimap when triggered.

options.label: Conditional Spoiler
options.description: Minimal behaviour, and if the Mask of Truth is aquired along with Map of Clock Town, spoil the maze layout.

options.label: Spoiler
options.description: Only Map of Clock Town needed to spoil the maze layout.

label: Safer Glitches
description: Makes it safer to use glitches: - Prevents HESS crash - Prevents Weirdshot crash - Prevents Action Swap crash - Prevents Song of Double Time softlock during 0th or 4th day - Prevents Tatl text softlock on 0th of 4th day - Prevents 0th day file deletion - Prevents hookslide crash - Prevents softlocks when using Remote Hookshot - Prevents 0th day Goron Bow crash - Applies safety fixes for Fierce Deity even if Fierce Deity Anywhere is not enabled - Index warp no longer crashes or softlocks (but you won't be able to use it to access the Debug Menu) - Prevents softlocks when interrupting mask transformations - Mayor is removed on 4th day - Deku Playground Employees are removed on 4th day - Prevents Gossip Stone time from crashing on 4th day - Prevents Town Shooting Gallery from crashing on 0th day and 4th day

label: Bombchu Drops
description: If you have found Bombchu, then any random Bomb drop or fixed non-randomized Bomb drop will have a chance to drop Bombchu instead. Where relevant, Bombchu packs of 1 and 5 will be in logic in addition to packs of 10.

label: Keg Drops
description: If you have found the Powder Keg, then any random Bomb drop or fixed non-randomized Bomb drop will drop a Powder Keg instead if you have 0 Powder Kegs. Logic will no longer require the ability to purchase Powder Kegs from the bomb shop goron.

label: Instant Transform
description: Transforming using Deku Mask, Goron Mask, Zora Mask and Fierce Deity's Mask will be almost instant. These items can no longer be used as "cutscene items".

label: Bomb Arrows
description: Use a bomb while an arrow is out when using the bow to attach the bomb to the tip of the arrow.

label: Fewer Health Drops
description: Recovery Hearts will not drop, and re-acquiring random items will turn into Green Rupees instead. Fairies will not heal except on death.

label: Easy Frame By Frame
description: Hold Start while unpausing to pause again after one frame passes.

label: Fairy Mask Shimmer
description: Nearby stray fairies, even randomized ones, will cause the Great Fairy Mask to shimmer.

label: Skulltula Token Sounds
description: Nearby skulltula tokens, even randomized ones, will emit a spider crawling sound.

label: Minor Drop Sparkle
description: Pots, Grass, Snowballs, Rocks, Crates, Barrels, Beehives, Flower Pots and Butterflies with randomized items will emit a sparkle.

label: Take Damage On Epona
description: Instead of being immune to damage while riding Epona, Link will take damage and be thrown off.

label: Take Damage While Shielding
description: Link will take damage when being hit on his shield, and can't recoil off damage to the shield.

label: Take Damage From Void
description: Link will take damage when falling into voids or voiding out in water.

label: Take Damage From Dog
description: Dogs will damage Deku Link.

label: Take Damage From Gorons
description: Link will take damage when being hit by Gorons during the Goron Race.

label: Take Damage Getting Caught
description: Getting thrown out after being caught by guards will deal damage. Being thrown out after getting the reward from the Imprisoned Monkey will not deal damage.

label: Take Damage From Gibdos Faster
description: Gibdos will deal damage immediately after grabbing Link.

label: Take Damage From Dexihands
description: Link will take damage from Dexihands.

label: Required Boss Remains
description: Set the number of Boss Remains required to proceed through the final Giants cutscene.

label: Logic Mode
description: Select mode of logic:

options.label: Casual
options.description: The randomization logic ensures that the game can be beaten casually.

options.label: Glitched
options.description: The randomization logic allows for placement of items that are only obtainable using known glitches.

options.label: User Logic
options.description: Upload your own custom logic to be used in the randomization.

options.label: No Logic
options.description: Completely random, no guarantee the game is beatable. Uses Glitched logic with all tricks enabled for HTML tracker and Blitz junk location calculation.

label: Item Placement
description: Select the order that items are placed. If you don't know what this does, just use Random.

label: Enabled tricks
description: Tricks the logic is allowed to expect from you.
default: Day 2 Grave Without Lens of Truth

label: Add Songs
description: Enable songs being placed among items in the randomization pool.

label: Randomize Gibdo Requirements
description: Enable randomization of Gibdo requirements. They can request ammo, bottle contents, quest and trade items, photos and masks.

label: Starting Item Mode
description: Select a starting item mode: None - You will not start with any randomized starting items. Random - You will start with randomized starting items. Allow Temporary Items - You will start with randomized starting items including Keg, Magic Bean and Bottles with X.

label: Small Key Mode
description: How dungeon small keys work: doors can start open, keys can be kept after the Song of Time, and keys can be limited to where they may be placed.

options.label: Doors Open
options.description: Small Key doors will always be open. Small Keys in the item pool will be replaced with other items. Other item placement restrictions will apply to the replacements too.

options.label: Keep Within Temples
options.description: Randomization algorithm will place any randomized Small Keys into any temple.

options.label: Keep Within Area
options.description: Randomization algorithm will place any randomized Small Keys into a location in or near the temple they're used in.

options.label: Keep Within Overworld
options.description: Randomization algorithm will place any randomized Small Keys into an overworld location.

options.label: Keep Through Time
options.description: Small Keys will go back in time with Link. Any used Small Keys will return to Link's inventory.

label: Boss Key Mode
description: How boss keys work: boss doors can start open, keys can be kept after the Song of Time, and keys can be limited to where they may be placed.

options.label: Doors Open
options.description: Boss doors will always be open. Boss Keys in the item pool will be replaced with other items. Other item placement restrictions will apply to the replacements too.

options.label: Great Fairy Rewards
options.description: Boss Keys will be placed on the reward for collecting 15 stray fairies of their dungeon. Great Fairy Rewards must be randomized for this to take effect.

options.label: Keep Within Temples
options.description: Randomization algorithm will place any randomized Boss Keys into any temple.

options.label: Keep Within Area
options.description: Randomization algorithm will place any randomized Boss Keys into a location in or near the temple it's used in.

options.label: Keep Within Overworld
options.description: Randomization algorithm will place any randomized Boss Keys into an overworld location.

options.label: Keep Through Time
options.description: Boss Keys will go back in time with Link.

label: Stray Fairy Mode
description: How stray fairies are shuffled: only the ones in chests, or limited to where they may be placed.

options.label: Chests Only
options.description: Stray Fairies in the item pool will be replaced with other items. Other item placement restrictions will apply to the replacements too. Non-chest fairies (roaming, bubbles, beehives, etc.) are removed. Chests that ordinarily have a Stray Fairy will behave like normal chests.

options.label: Keep Within Temples
options.description: Randomization algorithm will place any randomized Stray Fairies into any temple.

options.label: Keep Within Area
options.description: Randomization algorithm will place any randomized Stray Fairies into a location in or near the fairy fountain they originate from.

options.label: Keep Within Overworld
options.description: Randomization algorithm will place any randomized Stray Fairies into an overworld location.

label: Boss Remains Mode
description: Where boss remains can be placed, and Blitz options that give you some remains at the start.

options.label: Great Fairy Rewards
options.description: Boss Remains will be placed on the reward for collecting 15 stray fairies of their dungeon. Great Fairy Rewards must be randomized for this to take effect.

options.label: Shuffle Only
options.description: Boss Remains will be shuffled among each other. You still need to randomize them in the Item Randomization tab.

options.label: Keep Within Temples
options.description: Randomization algorithm will place any randomized Boss Remains into any temple.

options.label: Keep Within Area
options.description: Randomization algorithm will place any randomized Boss Remains into a location in or near the temple its boss is in.

options.label: Keep Within Overworld
options.description: Randomization algorithm will place any randomized Boss Remains into an overworld location.

options.label: Blitz1
options.description: Start with 1 random boss remains. Locations in and after the temple with that boss will be forced to be junk.

options.label: Blitz2
options.description: Start with 2 random boss remains. Locations in and after the temples with those bosses will be forced to be junk.

options.label: Blitz3
options.description: Start with 3 random boss remains. Locations in and after the temples with those bosses will be forced to be junk.

options.label: Blitz4
options.description: Start with all boss remains. Locations in and after temples will be forced to be junk.

label: Price Mode
description: Which prices are randomized: shop purchases, minigames, and other paid things.

options.label: Purchases
options.description: Prices for item purchases will be randomized.

options.label: Minigames
options.description: Prices for minigames will be randomized.

options.label: Misc
options.description: Prices for other miscellaneous spending will be randomized.

options.label: Account For Royal Wallet
options.description: Price randomization will range from 1-999 instead of 1-500. Any shuffled or non-randomized price will double.

options.label: Shuffle Only
options.description: Prices will only be shuffled among each other. Must enable Puchases, Minigames or Misc for this setting to have any effect.

label: Dungeon Navigation Mode
description: Where dungeon maps and compasses can be placed, and what they show.

options.label: Keep Within Temples
options.description: Randomization algorithm will place any randomized Dungeon Maps and Compasses into any temple.

options.label: Keep Within Area
options.description: Randomization algorithm will place any randomized Dungeon Maps and Compasses into a location in or near the temple they're for.

options.label: Keep Within Overworld
options.description: Randomization algorithm will place any randomized Dungeon Maps and Compasses into an overworld location.

options.label: Map Reveals Location
options.description: Finding a Dungeon Map will tell you the location of the dungeon.

options.label: Compass Reveals Boss
options.description: Finding a Compass will tell you which boss is in the dungeon.

label: Victory Mode
description: What you need to do to finish the game. Pick any combination; with none, you beat Majora as usual.

options.label: Direct To Credits
options.description: Once the custom victory condition(s) is/are fulfilled, begin the credits as soon as possible. Otherwise, you must fulfill the condition(s) and then defeat Majora.

options.label: Cant Fight Majora
options.description: When enabled, speaking to the Moon Child who is wearing Majora's Mask will send you back in time if you haven't fufilled the victory condition(s). When disabled, defeating Majora will send you back in time if you haven't fulfilled the victory condition(s).

options.label: Fairies
options.description: Have 15 of each dungeon stray fairy.

options.label: Skull Tokens
options.description: Have 30 of each type of skulltula token.

options.label: Non Transformation Masks
options.description: Have all 20 non-transformation masks.

options.label: Transformation Masks
options.description: Have all 4 transformation masks.

options.label: Notebook
options.description: Have all the notebook entries.

options.label: Hearts
options.description: Have all 20 hearts.

options.label: One Boss Remains
options.description: Have one of the boss remains. Only the highest boss remain victory condition enabled will be used.

options.label: Two Boss Remains
options.description: Have two of the boss remains. Only the highest boss remain victory condition enabled will be used.

options.label: Three Boss Remains
options.description: Have three of the boss remains. Only the highest boss remain victory condition enabled will be used.

options.label: Four Boss Remains
options.description: Have all the boss remains. Only the highest boss remain victory condition enabled will be used.

label: Entrance Mode
description: Which entrances are shuffled, so a door can lead somewhere unexpected.

options.label: Dungeon Entrances
options.description:
Enable randomization of dungeon entrances. 

Stone Tower Temple is always vanilla, but Inverted Stone Tower Temple is randomized.

options.label: Boss Rooms
options.description: Enable randomization of boss rooms. The boss door texture will match the boss behind the door.

options.label: Grottos
options.description: Enable randomization of grottos. North Clock Town grotto and Deku Palace grotto will never be generic grottos or cow grottos.

options.label: Simple Interiors
options.description: Enable randomization of simple interiors.

label: Enemy Mode
description: Randomize which enemies and other actors appear.

options.label: Randomized
options.description: Enable randomization of enemies. May cause softlocks in some circumstances, use at your own risk.

options.label: Hyper
options.description: Double the rate at which enemies are updated, making them more difficult.

label: Randomized locations
description: Locations whose contents are shuffled. Everything else keeps its vanilla item.

label: Starting items
description: Items you start the game with.

label: Random Starting Item Groups
description: Lists of items you'll start with a few of, chosen at random each seed.

label: Junk locations
description: Locations that will never contain an important item.

label: Trap Amount
description: Amount of ice traps to be added to pool by replacing junk items.

label: Trap Weights
description: How likely each kind of trap is, compared to the others. 0 means that trap never appears.

label: Trap Appearance
description: Appearance of ice traps in pool for world models.

label: Damage Mode
description: Select a damage mode, affecting how much damage Link takes:

options.label: Default
options.description: Link takes normal damage.

options.label: Doom
options.description: Hardcore mode. Link's hearts are slowly being drained continuously.

label: Death Mode
description: Select a death mode, affecting what happens when Link dies:

options.label: Default
options.description: Nothing out of the ordinary.

options.label: Moon Crash
options.description: The moon will crash.

options.label: Reduce Max Hearts
options.description: Reduces the maximum number of hearts by one (or by half if you have Double Defense) and current health is restored to full. If you run out of hearts, the moon crashes.

label: Damage Effect
description: Select an effect to occur whenever Link is being damaged:

options.label: Default
options.description: Vanilla effects occur.

options.label: Fire
options.description: All damage burns Link.

options.label: Ice
options.description: All damage freezes Link.

options.label: Shock
options.description: All damage shocks link.

options.label: Knockdown
options.description: All damage knocks Link down.

options.label: Random
options.description: Any random effect of the above.

label: Movement Mode
description: Select a movement modifier:

options.label: Default
options.description: No movement modifier.

options.label: High Speed
options.description: Link moves at a much higher velocity.

options.label: Super Low Gravity
options.description: Link can jump very high.

options.label: Low Gravity
options.description: Link can jump high.

options.label: High Gravity
options.description: Link can barely jump.

label: Floor Type
description: Select a floortype for every floor ingame:

options.label: Default
options.description: Vanilla floortypes.

options.label: Sand
options.description: Link sinks slowly into every floor, affecting movement speed.

options.label: Ice
options.description: Every floor is slippery.

options.label: Snow
options.description: Similar to sand.

options.label: Random
options.description: Any random floortypes of the above.

label: Nut and Stick Drops
description: Adds Deku nuts and Deku sticks to drop tables in the field:

options.label: Default
options.description: No change, vanilla behavior.

options.label: Light
options.description: one stick and nut 1/16 chance termina bush.

options.label: Medium
options.description: More nuts, twice the chance

options.label: Extra
options.description: More sticks, more nuts, more drop locations.

options.label: Mayhem
options.description: You're crazy in the coconut!

label: Clock Speed
description: Modify the speed of time.

label: Hide Clock
description: Clock UI will be hidden.

label: Blast Mask Cooldown
description: Adjust the cooldown timer after using the Blast Mask.

label: Enable Suns Song
description: Enable using the Sun's Song, which speeds up time to 400 units per frame (normal time speed is 3 units per frame) until dawn or dusk or a loading zone.

label: Allow Fierce Deity Anywhere
description: Allow the Fierce Deity's Mask to be used anywhere. Also addresses some softlocks caused by Fierce Deity.

label: Byo Ammo
description: Arrows, Bombs, and Bombchu will not be provided for minigames. You must bring your own. Logic Modes other than No Logic will account for this.

label: Moon Crash Erases File
description: If the moon crashes, your save files will be erased.

label: Hookshot Any Surface
description: Hookshot can hook to any surface.

label: Vanilla Moon Trial Access
description: Entering the trials on the Moon will require masks, as per the vanilla behavior, but this is not considered by logic. Without this enabled, the trials will not require any masks to enter.

label: General cutscenes
description: Shorten or skip these cutscenes and waits.

options.label: Blast Mask Thief
options.description: You don't have to wait for Sakon to leave.

options.label: Boat Archery
options.description: The minigame will end as soon as you have the required 20 points.

options.label: Fisherman Game
options.description: The minigame will end as soon as you have the required 20 points.

options.label: Milk Bar Performance
options.description: Replaying of the music is shortened.

options.label: Hungry Goron
options.description: The Hungry Goron doesn't interrupt you when you approach, and you don't have to watch him roll away.

options.label: Tatl Interrupts
options.description: Remove most instances of Tatl interrupting your gameplay.

options.label: Faster Bank Text
options.description: Skips the irrelevant bank text. Allows using Z/R to set deposit/withdraw amount to min/max.

options.label: Goron Village Owl
options.description: The owl in Goron Village will no longer trigger dialog when you approach. You must target it and talk to it if you want it to reveal the path.

options.label: Automatic Credits
options.description: The dialog of the credits will proceed automatically.

options.label: Princess Delivery
options.description: The cutscene when delivering the Deku Princess will be skipped.

options.label: Short Chest Opening
options.description: All chests will open using the short animation.

options.label: Sun Mask
options.description: Shorten various aspects of recovering the Sun Mask.

options.label: Tingle
options.description: You don't have to watch Tingle fall, and his text is shortened.

options.label: Jim Running
options.description: You don't have to watch Jim run away after using the Bombers' code.

options.label: Kotake
options.description: You don't have to watch Kotake fly into the woods, and don't have to watch her fly away after giving you an item.

options.label: Hold A Text
options.description: Hold A to automatically advance text.

options.label: Everything Else
options.description: Various cutscenes are skipped or otherwise shortened.

label: Boss intros
description: Skip these boss introduction cutscenes.

options.label: Odolwa
options.description: Odolwa is ready to fight you right away.

options.label: Goht
options.description: Link doesn't look around in surprise when you enter Goht's room.

options.label: Gyorg
options.description: Gyorg is ready to fight you right away.

options.label: Twinmold
options.description: Twinmold is ready to fight you right away.

options.label: Majora
options.description: Majora is ready to fight you right away.

options.label: Wart
options.description: You don't have to look at Wart to get him down from the ceiling. It spawns on the ground.

options.label: Igos Du Ikana
options.description: Igos du Ikana and his henchmen are ready to fight you right away.

options.label: Gomess
options.description: Gomess and his bats are ready to fight you right away.

label: Quick Text Enabled
description: Enable quick text. Dialogs are fast-forwarded to choices/end of dialog.

label: Character
description: Select a character model to replace Link's default model.

label: Gossip Hint Style
description: Select a Gossip Stone hint style

options.label: Default
options.description: Vanilla Gossip Stone hints.

options.label: Random
options.description: Hints will contain locations of random items.

options.label: Relevant
options.description: Hints will contain locations of items loosely related to the vanilla hint or the area.

options.label: Competitive
options.description: Guaranteed hints about time-consuming checks, and hints regarding importance or non-importance of regions

label: Garo Hint Style
description: Select a Garo hint style

options.label: Default
options.description: Vanilla Garo hints.

options.label: Random
options.description: Hints will contain locations of random items.

options.label: Relevant
options.description: Hints will contain locations of items loosely related to the vanilla hint or the area.

options.label: Competitive
options.description: Guaranteed hints about time-consuming checks, and hints regarding importance or non-importance of regions.

label: Mix Gossip And Garo Hints
description: Garo hints distribution and gossip hint distribution will be mixed together.

label: Free Hints
description: Enable reading gossip stone hints without requiring the Mask of Truth.

label: Free Garo Hints
description: Enable fighting Garos by speaking to Tatl instead of wearing the Garo's Mask.

label: Clear Hints
description: Gossip stone hints will give clear item and location names.

label: Clear Garo Hints
description: Garo hints will give clear item and location names.

label: Importance Count
description: Gossip stone hints that normally give a Way of the Hero hint will instead tell you the number of important items in the region. Foolish hints will say zero important items. Foolish Except The Song hints will say one important song.

label: Importance Count Garo
description: Garo hints that normally give a Way of the Hero hint will instead tell you the number of important items in the region. Foolish hints will say zero important items. Foolish Except The Song hints will say one important song.

label: Tolerant Gossip Stones
description: The angle at which Gossip Stones can be read will be more tolerant.

label: Hints Indicate Importance
description: Location hints indicate the importance of the item.

label: Override Number Of Required Gossip Hints
description: Set the number of Way of the Hero hints that will appear on Gossip Stones.

label: Override Number Of Non Required Gossip Hints
description: Set the number of Foolish hints that will appear on Gossip Stones.

label: Override Max Number Of Clock Town Gossip Hints
description: Set the maximum number of Way of the Hero hints on Gossip Stones that can be for a Clock Town region (including Laundry Pool).

label: Override Number Of Required Garo Hints
description: Set the number of Way of the Hero hints that will appear on Garos.

label: Override Number Of Non Required Garo Hints
description: Set the number of Foolish hints that will appear on Garos.

label: Override Max Number Of Clock Town Garo Hints
description: Set the maximum number of Way of the Hero hints on Garos that can be for a Clock Town region (including Laundry Pool).

label: Override Hint Priorities
description: If any locations are provided, this list will be used exclusively for determining hint priorities. Settings are not taken into account, but non-randomized and junked locations will not be hinted. The higher a location appears in this list, the higher its priority. Locations with the same priority will be chosen randomly. If a location should combine with another location, all the combined locations should be added.

label: Override Importance Indicator Tiers
description: Make chosen tiers of hints indicate their importance.

label: Override Hint Item Caps
description: The number (if non-zero) indicates how many of the locations in the tier will be hinted, and the rest will be forced to be junk.

label: Prevent Downgrades
description: Downgrading items will be prevented.

label: Update Chests
description: Chest appearance will be updated to match the item they contain.

label: Update NPC Text
description: NPC text that refers to items and their locations will be updated.

label: Oath Hint
description: When you take the boss warp after defeating a temple boss, if you have enough boss remains to go to the moon and do not have Oath to Order then a cutscene will play in which the Giants reveal to you the region where the Oath to Order is located. If Mix Songs With Items is disabled, they will instead reveal the region of the Powder Keg, Captain's Hat, Mirror Shield, Deku Mask, Goron Mask or Zora Mask, depending on where the Oath to Order is.

label: Remains Hint
description: At the entrance to the Clock Tower Interior, Tatl will prompt to speak and will tell you the regions where the Boss Remains are located.

label: Fairy And Skull Hint
description: The cursed man in the Swamp Spider House, and the Green Shirt Man in the Ocean Spider House will tell you the regions of the remaining spider tokens. The Green Shirt Man in the Ocean Spider House will appear there when you blow up the entrance wall. Each fairy fountain (including Clock Town) will tell you the regions of the remaining Stray Fairies.

label: Fix Epona Sword
description: Change Epona's B button behavior to prevent you from losing your sword if you don't have a bow. May affect vanilla glitches that use Epona's B button.

label: Enable Pictobox Subject
description: Display extra text showing which type of picture was captured by the Pictobox.

label: Lenient Goron Spikes
description: Goron spikes can charge midair and keep their charge. Minimum speed for goron spikes is removed.

label: Keep Quest Trade Through Time
description: Quest items will return to your inventory after Song of Time.

label: Required Zora Eggs
description: Number of zora eggs that must be brought to the lab for the eggs to grow.

label: Speedup Beavers
description: Modify Beavers to not have to race the younger beaver.

label: Speedup Dampe
description: Change Dampe ghost flames to always have two on the ground floor and one up the ladder.

label: Speedup Dog Race
description: Make Gold Dog always win if you have the Mask of Truth.

label: Speedup Lab Fish
description: Change Lab Fish to only need to be fed one fish.

label: Speedup Bank
description: Change the Bank reward thresholds to 200/500/1000 instead of 200/1000/5000. Also reduces maximum bank capacity from 5000 to 1000.

label: Speedup Baby Cuccos
description: Makes the location of baby cuccos show on the minimap.

label: Hearts Selection
description: Hearts color selection used for HUD color override.

label: Magic Selection
description: Magic color selection used for HUD color override.

label: Shift Hue Misc UI
description: Shifts the color of miscellaneous UI elements.

label: Randomize Sounds
description: Randomize sound effects that are played throughout the game.

label: Tatl Color Schema
description: Select a color scheme to replace Tatl's default color scheme.

label: Music
description: Select a music option

options.label: Default
options.description: Vanilla background music.

options.label: Random
options.description: Randomized background music.

options.label: None
options.description: No background music.

label: Camera Style
description: Select a camera style.

options.label: Default
options.description: Vanilla camera.

options.label: Responsive
options.description: Link's movement will always be relative to the direction the camera is facing.

options.label: Instant
options.description: When Z-Targeting to move the camera behind Link, it will do it very quickly. Camera panning when climbing ledges is also sped up.

label: Enable Hold Z Targeting
description: Default Z-Targeting style to Hold.

label: Enable Night BGM
description: Enables playing daytime Background music during nighttime in the field. (Clocktown night music can be weird)

label: Keep Pictobox Antialiasing
description: Remove anti-aliasing from the Pictobox pictures, which is what makes Pictobox on emulator so slow.

label: Low Health Sound
description: Select a Low Health SFX setting:

options.label: Default
options.description: Vanilla sound.

options.label: Disabled
options.description: No sound will play.

options.label: Random
options.description: a random SFX will be chosen.

label: Disable Combat Music
description: Disables combat music around all regular (non boss or miniboss) enemies in the game.

label: Music Luck Roll Chance
description: Music Rando comes with a chance to accept a song from outside of its categories. - This controls the percentage chance of a Luck Roll allowing out-of-category music placement - This is per specific slot+song check - Only songs with their first category being a general category (0-16) are Luck Rollable.

label: Energy Colors
description: The colour of each form's energy effects, like sword spins and the Goron roll.

label: Tunic Colors
description: Each form's tunic colour, energy colours and ocarina instrument. Pick a colour to change it, or roll the dice for a random one.

label: Instruments
description: The instrument each form plays the ocarina songs with.

label: D Pad
description: Put items on the D-Pad for quick use, and choose which side of the screen it shows on.

label: Hud Colors
description: Colours of the buttons, hearts, magic meter, clock, minimap and rupees on screen.

label: Rainbow Tunic
description: Link's tunic color will slowly cycle its hue.

label: Bomb Traps Randomize Tunic Color
description: When you find a Bomb Trap, Link's tunic will randomly change color.

label: Remove Minor Music
description: Minor music such as indoors and grottos will not play. Background music that is already playing will instead continue.

label: Show Track Name
description: When a new track starts playing in-game, show the name of the track at the bottom left of the screen.

label: Disable Fanfares
description: Replace item fanfares and swamp shooting gallery fanfares with sound effects.
